lessons_used: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens (wait_info) was helpful (+8.9% measured, p=0.000775), slightly exceeding the predicted +8.0%.
Redesigning the pet customization stage (redesign) showed no clear effect (+3.7%, p=0.295), falling far short of the +12.0% prediction.
Deferring sign-in after pet selection (reorder/sign_in) showed no clear effect (+0.3%, p=0.907), far below the +10.0% prediction.
Predictions for redesigns and step reordering were significantly too optimistic.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Display & Launch Status Indicator
candidates.change: Add clear status indicators and desktop launch instructions on the waiting screen to explain how and where the pet will appear.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop, and the home waiting stage has long wait times (mean 2336s).

waiting.hint: Your pet will spawn directly on your desktop screen once generation is complete.

guard.reason: Adds helpful waiting screen information without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Wait screen info changes have proven successful (+8.9%); strong support and funnel evidence.

candidates.title: Account Persistence and Single Sign-In Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in options card to emphasize signing into an existing account so users do not accidentally create duplicate fresh accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top customer issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Log in with your primary account to keep and sync your saved desktop pets.

sign_in_options.text: Choose primary login method to restore existing pets.

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen
candidates.change: Insert a desktop controls quick reference screen before home_intro explaining how to drag, right-click, hide, and summon the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets explicitly noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, hide, or talk to it anytime.

components.text: Right-click for options menu, drag to move around desktop screen

guard.reason: Adds a valid new onboarding screen explaining controls before home_intro without skipping any required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off at finish and clear support complaints, but adding a new screen requires release and has moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Fast Track Path Choice Guidance
candidates.change: Display an explanatory hint comparing instant preset pets versus custom pet upload to reduce decision paralysis.
candidates.why: choose_path drop-off is 23.8% with an exceptionally long mean duration (514s).

choose_path.hint: Choose Preset Companion for instant setup, or Custom Pet to upload your own photo.

guard.reason: Adds path guidance while keeping both adoption options intact.

candidates.score_note: Cheap text/hint change for a step with 23.8% drop-off and high duration, though no explicit support tickets.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidance Flow
candidates.change: Add photo selection guidelines and tip carousel directly on the photo upload screen to prevent generation errors.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failure or distorted output, and adoption conversion is low (60.9%).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos for Best Results
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos with clear facial features for proper pet generation.

components.text: Avoid dark or blurry photos for best results.

guard.reason: Adds valid photo upload guidance within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and clear support issues, but new flow/carousel has higher cost and modest confidence.

candidates.title: Welcome Starter Gift Completion Incentive
candidates.change: Display a starter item gift badge on the home intro screen to reward completing onboarding.
candidates.why: The final step drops 35.2% of users (64.8% conversion) despite being the final step.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop! Here is Your Starter Item
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your screen with a complimentary starter item unlocked.

guard.reason: text in 'home_intro.body' talks about price or money

candidates.title: Explicit Account Pet Sync Copy
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and action button copy to explicitly state that signing in saves pet progress.
candidates.why: sign_in drops 27.1% of users, and support receives high volume regarding missing pets after re-login.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to attach your desktop pet to your account.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy clearly while maintaining the screen's core functionality.

candidates.score_note: High volume support issues and 27.1% sign_in drop-off; copy changes are cheap and low-risk.

candidates.title: Grid View Pet Companion Browse Layout
candidates.change: Change pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid layout for faster comparison of preset companions.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a median 89s and mean 1017s, indicating visual navigation drag.

pick_friend.hint: Click any companion card to select your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet picker layout while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns in adoption previously yielded insignificant results (+3.7%, p=0.295).

candidates.title: Spotlight Path Selection Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign choose_path using a spotlight layout with clear side-by-side action cards for quick selection.
candidates.why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s (over 8 minutes), pointing to high visual distraction or vagueness.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?

path_options.text: Quick Adopt or Custom Pet Creation

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Background Desktop Notification When Pet Ready
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet creation finishes.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time on home stage is 2336s (~38 min), causing users to switch away and abandon.

waiting.body: You can minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds desktop notification prompt during waiting screen, which is a permitted onboarding addition.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait times on home screen with notifications, building on proven wait-stage patterns.

picked: Desktop Pet Display & Launch Status Indicator

decisions.title: Desktop Pet Display & Launch Status Indicator

lessons_next: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning onboarding stages (redesign) and reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect, falling far short of optimistic predictions.
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy) and adding desktop status indicators showed no clear effect.
Predictions for redesigns, step reordering, copy changes, and guidance additions were consistently too high.
